pages.title: Understanding the Curse
pages.text: The $(curse)Khamsin Curse$() is an ancient affliction that spreads through cursed zones. It progresses through $(l)five stages$(), each more debilitating than the last.$(br2)Your $(gold)Ankh$() meter protects you. When it depletes in cursed areas, the curse takes hold.

pages.title: Curse Stages
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Stage I:$() Minor fatigue$(li)$(l)Stage II:$() Reduced strength$(li)$(l)Stage III:$() Hunger and weakness$(li)$(l)Stage IV:$() Severe debilitation$(li)$(l)Stage V:$() Near death$(br2)Remove the curse with $(item)Scroll of Unbinding$() or $(item)Tablet of Thoth$().

pages.title: Scroll of Unbinding
pages.text: Reduces Khamsin curse by one stage. Useful for managing the affliction when a full cure is unavailable.

pages.title: Tablet of Thoth
pages.text: The divine wisdom of $(deity)Thoth$() completely removes all Khamsin curse effects. A powerful but rare artifact.
